title: 许天师圣诞祝寿祈福法事公告
title_en: Announcement: Prayer Ceremony for Patriarch Xu Tianshi's Birthday
body:
农历正月二十八为净明祖师：神功妙济真君净明普化天尊许天师圣诞。为恭祝祖师圣诞，祈福消灾、增福延寿，美国阳翥道教协会特举行许天师圣诞祝寿祈福法事，依科设坛，上表启奏，以祈福消灾。

法会时间

2026年3月15日（星期日）

下午 1:00 – 3:00 PM

此时正值中国农历正月二十八

地点

28-35 45th St, 3A

Astoria, NY 11103

欢迎信众随喜功德参加法事上表祈福，请提供：姓名、生辰。亦可单独上表祈福。欢迎到场的善信自带鲜花果品供奉。

上表祈福，可求：

消灾解厄

延寿增福

身心安泰

事业顺利

财运亨通

家庭和合

诸事吉祥

本次法事由美国阳翥道教协会会长，净明派第二十六代嗣法弟子：吉法新道长主持。欢迎广大信众及皈依居士踊跃参加，恭祝圣寿，同沐恩光，共祈福佑。无法到场的信众将提供法会的照片视频。
body_en:
The 28th day of the first lunar month marks the birthday of Patriarch Xu Tianshi, the Jingming ancestor. To celebrate this sacred occasion and pray for blessings and disaster relief, the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America will hold a special prayer ceremony following orthodox ritual protocols.

Date

March 15, 2026 (Sunday)

1:00 – 3:00 PM

Coinciding with the 28th of the 1st lunar month

Venue

28-35 45th St, 3A

Astoria, NY 11103

Devotees are welcome to participate in the prayer ceremony. Please provide your name and date of birth. You may also submit individual prayer petitions. Attendees are welcome to bring fresh flowers and fruit offerings.

Prayer petitions may include:

Disaster Relief

Longevity & Blessings

Well-being

Career Success

Financial Prosperity

Family Harmony

Auspiciousness

This ceremony will be presided over by President Ji Faxin, the 26th generation successor of the Jingming lineage. All devotees and initiated laypeople are warmly welcome to attend, celebrating the sacred birthday and sharing in divine blessings. Photos and videos of the ceremony will be provided for those unable to attend in person.
